newsitem.title: MOROCCO: GOLF-SPAIN'S GARRIDO TAKES HASSAN II GOLF TROPHY.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-SPAIN'S GARRIDO TAKES HASSAN II GOLF TROPHY.

text.p: Spaniard Ignacio Garrido won the 25th Hassan II Golf Trophy title and the $93,000 first prize on Sunday with a final round score of 70 and a total of 279, 13 under par.
Zimbabwe's Nick Price with a final 74 and South African Wayne Westner after a closing 69 tied for second on 281.

Final scoreboard with fourth rounds: 279 Ignacio Garrido (Spain) 70 281 Nick Price (Zimbabwe) 74, Wayne Westner (South Africa) 69 283 Antoine Farry (France) 68 286 Lennie Clements (U.S.) 68, Mark Roe (Britain), Craig Stadler (U.S.) 76, Carl Sunesson (Spain) 72 287 Mathias Gronberg (Sweden) 71, Roger Chapman (Britain) 75 289 Sam Torrance (Britain) 72, Jesper Parnevik (Sweden) 68
